title: Can Entanglement-Induced Feature-Map Designs Improve Projected Quantum Kernels?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Projected quantum kernels (PQKs) have emerged as a notable approach to circumvent the hardness of machine learning tasks arising from the exponential dimensionality of the quantum Hilbert space. However, recent PQK studies often rely heavily on extensive classical hyperparameter tuning of the radial basis function (RBF) kernel parameter and the support vector machine regularization parameter. The extensive tuning can mask the true representational power of the underlying PQKs induced by quantum feature maps, which has not been explored in detail. Thus, this work aims to expose the structural capabilities of PQKs by isolating and evaluating their native inductive bias through comparisons between untuned and tuned PQKs against the RBF baseline. translated_title: 纠缠诱导的特征映射设计能否改进投影量子核？
translated_abstract: 投影量子核（PQKs）已成为一种规避由量子希尔伯特空间指数级维度所带来的机器学习任务困难的重要方法。然而，近期的PQK研究往往严重依赖于对径向基函数（RBF）核参数和支持向量机正则化参数进行大量的经典超参数调优。这种大规模调优可能会掩盖由量子特征映射所诱导的底层PQK的真实表征能力，而这一点尚未得到详细探究。因此，本工作旨在通过将未调优和已调优的PQK与RBF基线进行对比，分离并评估其固有的归纳偏置，从而揭示PQK的结构性能力。此外，我们提出了新颖的量子特征映射，利用双量子比特纠缠来捕获物联网（IoT）数据中的多变量相关性。结果表明，大规模调优可能导致竞争……
tldr: 本文提出利用双量子比特纠缠的新型量子特征映射来构建投影量子核以捕获物联网数据的多变量相关性，并通过未调优与调优PQK对比RBF基线来分离评估其固有归纳偏置与结构表征能力。
en_tdlr: This work proposes novel two-qubit entanglement-based quantum feature maps for projected quantum kernels to capture multivariate correlations in IoT data, and isolates their native inductive bias by comparing untuned and tuned PQKs against an RBF baseline.
